claims.assertion: Swaruu (9) describes Uranus as a gas giant with a progressively denser atmosphere and a solid diamond-like surface beneath extreme pressure.
claims.speaker: Swaruu (9)

claims.assertion: She says Miranda has under-ice animal and plant ecosystems sustained by geothermal vents, but no alien bases.
claims.speaker: Swaruu (9)

claims.assertion: She says other large Uranian moons host underground alien bases extracting mainly iron, carbon, gold, and alloy materials; the rings contain Tiamat debris.
claims.speaker: Swaruu (9)

claims.assertion: She describes lower-6D beings as non-local consciousnesses needing no form or place, but appearing as local entities to interact with lower-density observers.
claims.speaker: Swaruu (9)

review_flags: The source distinguishes Miranda’s lack of bases from bases on other Uranian moons.
coverage_gaps: life on moons other than Miranda
